feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller reduces base_speed slightly to 1.35 to lower aggressive driving, increases kd to 4.0 for stronger damping, and keeps kp at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights remain at [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], preserving steering balance. The geometry is unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. These changes aim to reduce oscillations and line loss events while maintaining good progress. I recommend approving this candidate to race and collect telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these improvements. No further changes are requested before racing.
